### Scaffold project with tiged

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/index.md

Create a local copy of a community template hosted on GitHub. Installs dependencies and starts the development server.

```bash
npx tiged user/project my-project
cd my-project

npm install
npm run dev
```

### Install SWC plugins with Deno

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/migration.md

Installs @rollup/plugin-swc and @swc/core using Deno as a workaround for lowering native decorators.

```bash
$ deno add -D npm:@rollup/plugin-swc npm:@swc/core
```

--------------------------------

### Create and start a Vite dev server with createServer

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/api-javascript.md

Initializes, starts, and prints URLs for a Vite development server programmatically with custom port and root configurations.

```ts
import { createServer } from 'vite'

const server = await createServer({
  // any valid user config options, plus `mode` and `configFile`
  configFile: false,
  root: import.meta.dirname,
  server: {
    port: 1337,
  },
})
await server.listen()

server.printUrls()
server.bindCLIShortcuts({ print: true })
```

### Preview production build with vite preview

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/cli.md

```bash

```

### Installing CSS pre-processors

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/features.md

# .styl and .stylus
npm add -D stylus
```

### Example .vite/manifest.json structure

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/backend-integration.md

Output generated in outDir after running vite build when manifest is enabled, mapping source entries to output assets and dependencies.

```json
{
  "_shared-B7PI925R.js": {
    "file": "assets/shared-B7PI925R.js",
    "name": "shared",
    "css": ["assets/shared-ChJ_j-JJ.css"]
  },
  "_shared-ChJ_j-JJ.css": {
    "file": "assets/shared-ChJ_j-JJ.css",
    "src": "_shared-ChJ_j-JJ.css"
  },
  "logo.svg": {
    "file": "assets/logo-BuPIv-2h.svg",
    "src": "logo.svg"
  },
  "baz.js": {
    "file": "assets/baz-B2H3sXNv.js",
    "name": "baz",
    "src": "baz.js",
    "isDynamicEntry": true
  },
  "views/bar.js": {
    "file": "assets/bar-gkvgaI9m.js",
    "name": "bar",
    "src": "views/bar.js",
    "isEntry": true,
    "imports": ["_shared-B7PI925R.js"],
    "dynamicImports": ["baz.js"]
  },
  "views/foo.js": {
    "file": "assets/foo-BRBmoGS9.js",
    "name": "foo",
    "src": "views/foo.js",
    "isEntry": true,
    "imports": ["_shared-B7PI925R.js"],
    "css": ["assets/foo-5UjPuW-k.css"]
  }
}
```

### configurePreviewServer

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/api-plugin.md

Hook for configuring the preview server and injecting custom middlewares before or after internal middlewares are installed. It accepts the PreviewServer instance and can return a post-hook function.

```APIDOC
## configurePreviewServer

### Description
Configures the preview server. Called before other middlewares are installed. Return a function to run after internal middlewares are installed.

### Type
`(server: PreviewServer) => (() => void) | void | Promise<(() => void) | void>`

### Kind
`async`, `sequential`

### Scope
Global

### Parameters
- **server** (`PreviewServer`) - The preview server instance.

### Return Value
- `(() => void) | void | Promise<(() => void) | void>` - An optional post hook function or promise of a post hook function called after internal middlewares are installed.

### Example
```js
const myPlugin = () => ({
  name: 'configure-preview-server',
  configurePreviewServer(server) {
    return () => {
      server.middlewares.use((req, res, next) => {
        // custom handle request...
      })
    }
  },
})
```
```

--------------------------------

### Start Vite with native config loader

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/config/index.md

Executes the original config file directly so breakpoints in the config file and plugin hooks map to the original source. Requires a runtime supporting the syntax used, such as Node.js 22.18+ for TypeScript files.

```bash
vite --configLoader native
```

Boots up a local static web server serving files from dist at http://localhost:4173 to verify the production build.

```bash
$ npm run preview
```

### Create entry index.html

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/index.md

Create an entry point HTML file in the project root. Vite treats this file as source code and part of the module graph.

```html
<p>Hello Vite!</p>
```

### Install esbuild for CSS minification

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/config/build-options.md

```sh

```

--------------------------------

### Import and initialize WebAssembly modules using ?init

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/blog/announcing-vite3.md

Import a WebAssembly file using the ?init query suffix and invoke the default export to instantiate the module.

```javascript
import init from './example.wasm?init'

init().then((instance) => {
  instance.exports.test()
})
```

### Install terser for legacy minification

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/packages/plugin-legacy/README.md

### Run a staging build with custom mode and .env.staging file

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/env-and-mode.md

Overrides the default production mode during build using the --mode flag and loads matching variables from .env.staging.

```bash
vite build --mode staging
```

```[.env.staging]
VITE_APP_TITLE=My App (staging)
```

```bash
$ npm run build
```

### Install unreleased Vite commit with pkg.pr.new

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/index.md

Installs a specific commit of Vite using pkg.pr.new to test unreleased features. Replace SHA with a Vite commit SHA from within the last month.

```bash
$ npm install -D https://pkg.pr.new/vite@SHA
```

```bash
$ yarn add -D https://pkg.pr.new/vite@SHA
```

```bash
$ pnpm add -D https://pkg.pr.new/vite@SHA
```

```bash
$ bun add -D https://pkg.pr.new/vite@SHA
```

### Start Vite dev server with profiling

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/troubleshooting.md

Starts the Vite dev server with the built-in Node.js inspector and opens the browser. After the application finishes loading, press 'p' in the terminal to stop the inspector and 'q' to stop the server.

```bash
vite --profile --open
```

--------------------------------

### Instantiate and execute code using ModuleRunner

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/api-environment-runtimes.md

Demonstrates initializing a `ModuleRunner` with an RPC transport and `ESModulesEvaluator` before executing an entry-point module.

```javascript
import {
  ModuleRunner,
  ESModulesEvaluator,
  createNodeImportMeta,
} from 'vite/module-runner'
import { transport } from './rpc-implementation.js'

const moduleRunner = new ModuleRunner(
  {
    transport,
    createImportMeta: createNodeImportMeta, // if the module runner runs in Node.js
  },
  new ESModulesEvaluator(),
)

await moduleRunner.import('/src/entry-point.js')
```

### Manually initialize WebAssembly with ?init

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/features.md

Imports a .wasm file using the ?init query suffix to receive an initialization function that resolves to a WebAssembly.Instance.

```js
import 'vite/client'
// ---cut---
import init from './example.wasm?init'

init().then((instance) => {
  instance.exports.test()
})
```

--------------------------------

### Inject post-middleware using configurePreviewServer

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/api-plugin.md

Inject custom middleware after internal middlewares are installed on the Vite preview server by returning a post-hook function.

```javascript
const myPlugin = () => ({
  name: 'configure-preview-server',
  configurePreviewServer(server) {
    // return a post hook that is called after other middlewares are
    // installed
    return () => {
      server.middlewares.use((req, res, next) => {
        // custom handle request...
      })
    }
  },
})
```

--------------------------------

### Build Library with Vite CLI

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/build.md

Execute vite build to produce production bundle artifacts for distribution.

```shell
$ vite build
building for production...
dist/my-lib.js      0.08 kB / gzip: 0.07 kB
dist/my-lib.umd.cjs 0.30 kB / gzip: 0.16 kB
```

--------------------------------

### Inject post-middleware using configureServer return callback

Source: https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/api-plugin.md

Return a function from configureServer to register middleware that runs after Vite's internal middlewares have been installed.

```javascript
const myPlugin = () => ({
  name: 'configure-server',
  configureServer(server) {
    // return a post hook that is called after internal middlewares are
    // installed
    return () => {
      server.middlewares.use((req, res, next) => {
        // custom handle request...
      })
    }
  },
})
```
